worked: The evocative hook 'THE COSMIC DRAIN' and opening line drove strong discovery and initial pickup, delivering 1,020 views and 41.5 views per hour—more than double the cohort average of ~20.5 views per hour.
hurt: Engagement softened due to documentary-style exposition in beats 2 through 5 (citing 2014, researcher R. Brent Tully, telescope names, and name origins), dragging likes per 100 down to 4.1 compared to the benchmark average of ~5.0.
A passive closing line ('our own Milky Way remains locked in this giant flow') produced 0 comments, missing the chance to spark debate or reaction.
diagnosis.change_next: Cut the academic attribution beats (dates, telescope names, researcher names) to maintain momentum, and rewrite the final beat into an open unresolved question such as: 'What is waiting at the center of the Great Attractor—and what happens when we arrive?' to drive viewer comments.
